ai.title: GPT-6.1 Terra fast-tier routing constants
ai.summary: The shared model catalog in `common` adds `FREEBUFF_GPT_61_TERRA_FAST_UPSTREAM_ORDER` and `FREEBUFF_GPT_61_TERRA_FAST_MAX_PRICE` to support the first-thread A/B experiment for GPT-6.1 Terra. The routing order prioritizes OpenAI's `openai/fast` endpoint with the standard tier as a backup, ensuring a capacity refusal results in a slower turn rather than a failure. The price ceiling is set to $2.50/$12.50 per million tokens to strictly exceed the fast tier's $2/$10 card while remaining below any higher bands.
ai.evidence: The diff adds two new constants in `common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts`: `FREEBUFF_GPT_61_TERRA_FAST_UPSTREAM_ORDER` (defining the routing sequence for OpenAI's `fast` tier) and `FREEBUFF_GPT_61_TERRA_FAST_MAX_PRICE` (the associated cost fence).

This is an internal configuration update that prepares the system for a controlled test of this model; it does not change any model availability, pricing, or features for you right now.

ai.title: Add streak milestone sharing types and placement to common
ai.summary: The shared constants and types packages gain support for the `streak_share_2026_11` experiment, which lets a workspace offer to share a reached streak milestone via social media. A new `streak` entry is added to `REFERRAL_INVITE_VIA` so the streak dialog's invite links are tracked distinctly from other placements, and `ReferralInviteAction` extends with `posted_x` and `posted_linkedin` to capture those social share events. The `workspacePreferencesSchema` adds an optional `streakShareShownThrough` integer (max 100000) to remember the highest milestone shown per account, while `FreebuffStreakResponse` gains a `shareMilestone` field that freebuff.com's `/api/web/streak` endpoint sets for the share arm.
ai.evidence: The diff adds a `streak` placement to `REFERRAL_INVITE_VIA` in `common/src/constants/product-funnel.ts` with values `streak_link` and `streak_email`, adds `streakShareShownThrough` to `workspacePreferencesSchema` in `common/src/desktop-cloud/workspace-preferences.ts`, adds `shareMilestone` to `FreebuffStreakResponse` in `common/src/types/freebuff-streak.ts`, and extends `ReferralInviteAction` with `posted_x` and `posted_linkedin` in `common/src/types/theme-referral.ts`.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the workspace UI code that renders the share dialog or the server logic that sets `shareMilestone`; only the shared schema additions are present.

eli5.text: Preparatory definitions were added so the free coding assistant can eventually offer you a chance to post your recent daily-use milestone to social platforms like X or LinkedIn. This update is internal plumbing that sets up the tracking rules and data storage needed for that feature; it does not change anything you see or do today. The definitions are in place and do nothing yet, and no user-facing behavior has changed.
